svg.text: execution architecture — grounding, gates and one generating agent
↺ = same contract reused by another mode, see its full-mode row
bold = key name · italic = condition, bound or opt-out
no FAN · ‖ = batched tool calls in one turn
snakes left → right, then right → left

g.text: WebFetch the competition URL, if given

svg.text: one composition.md row · plus notebook-style.md, style-rules.md
● own · ↺ same contract file, different variant or context · ○ absent

g.text: ● ⚡PTL title · online or frozen on flag

svg.text: eight AskUserQuestion gates · one hard stop · one post-hoc deadline

g.text: instructions file only; token never enters context
no foundry:sw-engineer → exit 1 with install hint
skip → offered again after the next notebook
No FAN, no JOIN. Step 1 context reads are batched tool calls in one turn, in-block detail, never lanes.
One ▣: foundry:sw-engineer in the background, required — no fallback agent; checked on its notification.
--resume → agent extends that script in place
extend writes the output path as the resume target
CLI absent or unauthorized → URL and user facts
403 → accept rules on kaggle.com · 404 → bad slug
listing fills 200 rows → PARTIAL, counts untrusted
WebFetch keeps narrative and metric prose
Tags: step N = SKILL.md step · Section N = notebook section in modes/*.md.
Diagram only — SKILL.md is normative; update both with any step/gate/fan-out change.
